pipeline_overview.name: 阶段剧情节点编译
pipeline_overview.purpose: 把世界书、运行态、战斗结果和玩家线索整理成 NarrativeEventBundle。

pipeline_overview.name: 世界状态变化提交
pipeline_overview.purpose: 把可接受的剧情与玩法意图转成受控 WorldStateDelta。

pipeline_overview.name: 剧情玩法联合契约
pipeline_overview.purpose: 证明剧情节点不是纯文本，而是闭环到任务、随机事件、研究、资源、NPC、地图节点或蓝图。

pipeline_overview.name: 游戏资产编译
pipeline_overview.purpose: 把提案或玩家构想编译为防御塔、道具、情报资产或临时改造候选。

pipeline_overview.name: 媒体与特效管线
pipeline_overview.purpose: 为可用资产生成图像、视频帧、抠图后处理和 runtime media manifest。
pipeline_overview.gate: media consistency / readiness validators; MVP 可 fallback

pipeline_overview.name: 阶段候选包构建
pipeline_overview.purpose: 把单阶段剧情、状态变化、玩法对象、资产和 runtime 引用合并成可审查候选单元。

pipeline_overview.name: 总审查交付包构建
pipeline_overview.purpose: 把阶段候选包、可编译对象目录、运行态、资产和验证命令汇总成总审查证据。

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_controlled_narrative_world_progression.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: battle result + RunWorldState -> controlled NarrativeEventBundle -> WorldStateDelta -> next RunWorldState. No live provider calls.

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_world_delta_semantic_gate_demo.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: Deterministic demo: repaired WorldStateDelta -> semantic gate -> apply_delta. No provider calls.

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_live_world_delta_guarded.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: battle result -> LLM-guarded WorldStateDelta -> next RunWorldState: first live LLM closed loop. WARNING: this workflow calls a real LLM provider. Only execute when you explicitly intend to make live API calls.

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_defense_asset_compile.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: defense asset compile: proposal -> validate -> mock compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_live_asset_compile_guarded.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: LIVE guarded asset compile: load proposal -> validate -> LLM compile with validation guard -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary. WARNING: this workflow calls a real LLM provider and must be explicitly executed by a human.

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_live_asset_media_repair_guarded.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: LIVE guarded media repair loop: generate media -> deterministic/vision review -> build repair plan -> regenerate failed roles -> merge -> re-review -> media processing -> published manifest -> runtime readiness gate. WARNING: calls real image and vision providers.

pipeline_overview.name: mvp_image_to_video_sprite_compile.workflow
pipeline_overview.purpose: LIVE guarded route: animation seed image -> image-to-video -> keyframe extraction -> keyframe selection -> batch cutout/alignment -> sprite sheet/atlas -> runtime readiness. Calls video provider only when allow_live_provider_call=true.

workflow_reviews.description: battle result -> narrative -> WorldStateDelta -> next RunWorldState: first complete closed loop
battle result + RunWorldState -> controlled NarrativeEventBundle -> WorldStateDelta -> next RunWorldState. No live provider calls.
defense asset compile: proposal -> validate -> mock compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary

LIVE guarded route: animation seed image -> image-to-video -> keyframe extraction -> keyframe selection -> batch cutout/alignment -> sprite sheet/atlas -> runtime readiness. Calls video provider only when allow_live_provider_call=true.

LIVE guarded asset compile: load proposal -> validate -> LLM compile with validation guard -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary. WARNING: this workflow calls a real LLM provider and must be explicitly executed by a human.

LIVE guarded asset compile using Ark Coding Plan Kimi: load proposal -> validate -> LLM compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> score -> pipeline summary. WARNING: this workflow calls a real LLM provider and must be explicitly executed by a human.

LIVE guarded asset media generation with asset-type auto roles: load compiled candidate -> generate images -> media review -> media processing -> published manifest -> runtime readiness gate. WARNING: calls real image and vision providers.

LIVE guarded asset media generation: load compiled candidate -> generate images with image provider -> remove_background_stub -> crop_and_pad_stub -> normalize_canvas_stub -> assign_anchor_stub -> pack_sprite_sheet_stub -> build_atlas_json_stub (runtime_public) -> check_runtime_readiness. WARNING: this workflow calls a real image provider and must be explicitly executed by a human. The generated raw media flows through the processing chain; only the final published manifest is runtime_public.

LIVE guarded media repair loop: generate media -> deterministic/vision review -> build repair plan -> regenerate failed roles -> merge -> re-review -> media processing -> published manifest -> runtime readiness gate. WARNING: calls real image and vision providers.
LIVE guarded intel asset compile: load intel_asset proposal -> validate -> LLM compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary.
LIVE guarded support item compile: load support_item proposal -> validate -> LLM compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary.
LIVE guarded temporary mod compile: load temporary_mod proposal -> validate -> LLM compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary.

battle result -> LLM-guarded WorldStateDelta -> next RunWorldState: first live LLM closed loop. WARNING: this workflow calls a real LLM provider. Only execute when you explicitly intend to make live API calls.
Build visual identity, check media quality, then check consistency for a compiled support item media sequence.
media processing publish: raw_media -> remove_background -> crop_and_pad -> normalize_canvas -> assign_anchor -> pack_sprite_sheet -> build_atlas_json (published_media, runtime_public)
Build visual identity, deterministic media reports, then convert a sample vision review failure into a prompt repair plan.
raw/imported media stub metadata -> published media manifest stub, demonstrating raw_media -> published_media layering
player proposal -> validate -> mock compile -> validate candidate -> simulate -> pipeline summary
narrative world growth: battle_result + session_context -> NPC feedback + world growth events (player-visible, world-in-language only)

LIVE guarded hidden compiler front-end: free player utterance -> PlayerIntent -> AssetDesignSpec -> deterministic legalization -> AssetPlan -> player-visible Proposal. This workflow calls a real LLM only in the guarded parsing/spec-building nodes.

DETERMINISTIC hidden compiler front-end: load fixture AssetDesignSpec -> deterministic legalization -> AssetPlan -> player-visible Proposal. No LLM calls. Bypasses intent.parse_player_utterance_guarded, asset.build_design_spec_guarded, and graph.select_compile_template_guarded.
locked manifest + first battle config -> research delivery payload stub
Deterministic demo: repaired WorldStateDelta -> semantic gate -> apply_delta. No provider calls.
